verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: Command the children of Israel to take for you pure wine, so that they may light a lamp forever.
verses.3: Outside the tent of meeting, in the tabernacle of God, Aaron will prepare it from evening until night, before Jehovah’s presence. This is a everlasting ordinance for your generations.
verses.4: On the pure altar, the offerings will be offered before Jehovah forever.
verses.5: And you took a towel and washed it. Then, twelve wounds were created. Twelve more wounds will be added to that total.
verses.6: And you placed them in two rows, according to the six rows that are arranged on the pure table before Jehovah.
verses.7: And you gave to the ark a pure offering; it became a memorial for God’s name.
verses.8: On the day of Shabbat, in the day of Shabbat, we shall be prepared before Jehovah. Everlasting covenant will be made with the children of Israel.
verses.9: And it became Aaron and his sons’ property. They ate it in a holy place, for it was a holy thing. It belonged to them as a gift from Jehovah, a law that lasts forever.
verses.10: And there was a son of an Israeli woman. He was the son of a Egyptian man, among the children of Israel. They were captured in the camp by the Israelites and that Egyptian man too.
verses.11: And the son of the Israelite woman named Shemera received that name. He was despised by others, and they brought him before Moses. His mother’s name was Shulamit, daughter of Dibri.
verses.12: And he placed it in the ark, so that it could be used by them according to Jehovah’s will.
verses.13: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.14: They took the pole and moved it outside the camp. They placed their hands on his head, and all the people prayed for him.
verses.15: And to the children of Israel, I will say, “Each person shall speak, saying that he has sinned against his God.”
verses.16: And the name of Jehovah died; all the people mourned over him. They wept for his death.
verses.17: And anyone who kills any human being will die as well.
verses.18: And one should kill the soul in the animal; let it be killed beneath the body.
verses.19: And anyone who gives his life to his neighbor, just as he did, will be treated accordingly.
verses.20: Under one’s eyes, there’s another eye; under the eyelids, there’s another eyelid. Just as a person’s body is divided into different parts, so too is it divided into these various components.
verses.21: And if a beast is killed, it will be punished; but if a human being is killed, he will die.
verses.22: One judgment will be given to you as a punishment. It will happen just as it was in the past, because I, Jehovah your God, am your God.
verses.23: Moses spoke to the children of Israel. They led him outside the camp. Then Aaron and the children of Israel did as God commanded Moses.
